items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: Would that have been like I remember having albums with him and Joe Farrell — two tenors?

ctx.x: It has, where I’ll be like, “Oh yeah I forgot about doing that.” It has happened where like I think that — is that even me? You know like it could be me. Because I did a lot of recordings in New York with different acts and different performers and artists and stuff. And I often remember most things but then yeah, something slips. Yeah I did that or even — but it’s kind of a cool thing to have the experience of performing with so many people over the years and, you know, being influenced by their music and then…
Would that have been like I remember having albums with him and Joe Farrell — two tenors?
